problem: The public selfscan delivered only partial value and gated the remaining risks and quick wins behind personal data, while the homepage primary CTA asked for a meeting before product value was experienced.
change: Homepage primary CTA now routes to /zelfscan
Selfscan renamed/reframed as Bedrijfslek value-first experience
Full benchmark and three lowest-domain quick wins render before any lead capture
No mandatory personal-data form is required for the result
Direct portal order, demo and share actions follow the delivered value
Final-build authority and regression test preserve this acquisition path
truth_guardrails: No fabricated financial outcome or buying-intent claim
Paid order and realized revenue remain terminal commercial outcomes
expected_learning: Compare Bedrijfslek completion -> portal/demo/order-start -> paid order against the prior meeting-first path. Do not promote conclusions without observed outcomes.
root_cause: The selfscan was optimized for early lead capture instead of delivered value.
The homepage asked for a meeting before visitors experienced the diagnostic product promise.
prevention: Do not gate the primary promised diagnostic value behind PII.
Place contact, demo or checkout choices after useful on-screen value.
Preserve the Bedrijfslek path in final build transforms and regression tests.
